QueueItem.title: QueueItem
QueueItem.description: Public queue record without citizen PII, used for slot counts, queue board display, kiosk issuance, and ticket status lookup.

serviceTitle.description: Thai display title of the selected service.

counter.description: Assigned service counter number (1-3 for general, 1-5 for foreign).

slotId.description: Time slot identifier or kiosk time slot (e.g. 0830 or 0915-kiosk).

issuedTime.description: Bangkok HH:mm time string when ticket was issued at kiosk (empty for online bookings).

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the queue.

lookupHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of bookingCode and normalized citizen ID for verification without exposing PII.

identityHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest scoped to date+channel+idNumber for duplicate booking prevention without exposing PII.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the queue was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the queue was last updated.

QueueDetail.title: QueueDetail
QueueDetail.description: Restricted PII companion record linked 1:1 to a QueueItem, readable only by verified staff admins.

queueId.description: Document ID of the linked QueueItem.

date.description: Service appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD matching QueueItem.date for admin daily queries.

fullName.description: Citizen full name or kiosk counter label.

idNumber.description: Normalized Thai National ID or passport number ('-' for kiosk).

phone.description: Normalized Thai phone number ('-' for kiosk).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when detail record was created.

QueueLookup.title: QueueLookup
QueueLookup.description: Zero-PII point-lookup index keyed by SHA-256(bookingCode:idNumber) resolving to queueId for citizen self-service.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when lookup entry was created.

StaffAdmin.title: StaffAdmin
StaffAdmin.description: Authorized office staff Google account allowed to manage queues and view citizen booking details.

email.description: Verified lowercase Google email address of the staff member.

addedBy.description: Email of the admin who added this staff member.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when staff access was granted.

TestConnection.title: TestConnection
TestConnection.description: Read-only connectivity probe document checked on app startup.

/queues/{queueId}.description: Public zero-PII queue items queried by date for slot availability, live board, kiosk, check-in, and admin.

/queueDetails/{queueId}.description: Private citizen PII companion documents accessible exclusively to verified staff admins.

/queueLookups/{lookupHash}.description: Point-lookup index keyed by SHA-256 hash of bookingCode and citizen ID.

/staffAdmins/{email}.description: Staff allowlist keyed by lowercase Google email address.

/test/{docId}.description: Startup Firestore server connectivity test path.
